name: devcontainer
description: Container-first development: setup (multi-stage Containerfiles with a thin tools layer for agents and CI, human devcontainers, Podman or Docker, resource limits), infra (simulated external services), proxy (reverse-proxy simulation), workflow (day-to-day operation)

guardUx.title: Explain this guard's decisions
guardUx.description: When the guard denies or asks, say why in plain words and what to do instead (the guard still decides; this changes only the words)

leftoversToast.title: Show the container leftovers report
leftoversToast.description: Show the report leftovers.sh prints at session start (this project's leftover containers, images, volumes; a low disk), which only the model sees, as a toast

containersBand.title: Show the container and disk band
containersBand.description: Keep this project's container leftovers and a low disk above the prompt, read from leftovers.sh --json after container work (report only, nothing is removed)

containersRefreshSeconds.title: Container band refresh (seconds)
containersRefreshSeconds.description: Read the container report again after a turn at most this often (it is also read at session start and after container builds, runs and removals)

containersCommand.title: Offer the /containers command
containersCommand.description: Register /containers, which prints the full leftovers report and a pointer to wt.py resources
